features.description: Remove vehicle-specific protocols, official packs, Solutions, and executable fixtures from AIBA's product surface while retaining the historical video as documentation media.
steps: Remove vehicle-specific public schemas and TypeScript bindings.
Remove the official vehicle capability and Solution.
Remove vehicle-specific executable fixtures and smoke assertions.
Add a regression check that official product surfaces remain domain-neutral.
features.verification: No vehicle identifiers remain in Spec, official catalogs, Solutions, executable fixtures, source tests, or release artifacts; documentation video media may remain; pnpm check passes.

features.description: Define a framework-neutral ApplicationBlueprint contract for resources, fields, relationships, states, operations, authorization intent, events, UI intent, and acceptance evidence.
steps: Define a strict JSON Schema and TypeScript binding.
Define versioned, stable identifiers and bounded values.
Document that blueprints express intent rather than executable code.
features.verification: Schema and binding accept complete domain-neutral blueprints and reject unknown fields, dangling references, unsafe paths, unbounded values, and executable commands.

features.description: Compile a Blueprint deterministically into a dependency-ordered capability plan and non-executable Agent task graph.
steps: Load and semantically validate Blueprint references.
Resolve required capabilities and transitive dependencies deterministically.
Produce bounded Agent tasks with write scopes, invariants, and evidence requirements.
Reject cycles, missing capabilities, ambiguous triggers, invariant weakening, and command injection.
features.verification: Planner output is stable across runs and rejects dependency, reference, authorization, trigger, path, and executable-command attacks without executing pack content.

features.description: Expose Application Blueprint authoring and planning through short Agent-friendly CLI commands.
steps: Provide stable human and JSON output.
Advertise commands through Agent protocol, completion, and npm distribution tests.
features.verification: Compiled CLI creates a safe scaffold, plans it deterministically, returns structured errors, and advertises both commands to Agents and shell completion.

features.description: Plan Blueprint revisions without overwriting project-owned customization or silently changing security intent.
steps: Bind plans to exact Blueprint source hashes.
Classify additive, breaking, security-sensitive, and conflicting changes.
Preserve project-owned task resolutions across compatible revisions.
Reject stale plans and unresolved breaking or security-sensitive changes.
features.verification: v1-to-v2 tests preserve project-owned resolutions, surface security changes, reject stale source and unresolved conflicts, and never modify application code.

features.description: Verify the composition layer with a domain-neutral work collaboration application and bilingual guidance.
steps: Add a domain-neutral golden Blueprint fixture.
Exercise forms, dictionaries, files, tags, approvals, notifications, inbox, comments, search, reporting, and audit composition.
Add positive and adversarial end-to-end verification.
Update roadmap, architecture, quick start, Agent Skill, and release artifact checks.
features.verification: Domain-neutral fixture plans and upgrades end to end; bilingual docs and installed npm tarballs expose the workflow; pnpm check and hosted workflows pass.
